source_join_method: A disposable hosted checkout kept the selected Gboard companion and its manifest/lock, fetched the pinned public NaTune commit, checked both owners' selected Git blob IDs, and replaced only natune_journal.rs and natune-journal-check.rs for the test. The separate owner's worktree and index were not modified; no source branch was merged.

controls.ignored_test_limit: The existing owner-identity diagnostic remains ignored in the regular run; this join does not fix or re-evaluate that defect.
controls.scope: Public synthetic library controls and cross-compilation; no Android executable, model, microphone, user media, receiver or installed app was run.

artifact.name: purple-companion-join-diagnostic
artifact.binary_observation: Both binaries have ELF64 little-endian AArch64 headers. They were not executed on Android.
artifact.readback: The complete ZIP, all seven checksum-listed members, selected provenance and 13 source hashes were independently checked in memory. The two NaTune source hashes matched the owner's selected local commit; the others matched the hosted Gboard source commit.
artifact.retention: The hosted diagnostic artifact is temporary and is not a private archive or a release.

limits: This tests only the selected companion source join. It does not join or install the NaTune app, establish its original signing/data handoff or authenticated journal owner, validate a real source/receiver, release media, prove Gboard privacy or job recovery, or replace phone acceptance. It does not claim anything about later changes by either owner.
